meta.source: Shared stylesheet of five published pages: Dev Console (Chimera Board · Model Scout), Code Review Triage, Release Notes Drafter, Error Triage Board and Completion Log, July 2026. Values copied exactly.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind the shell.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, stat cards, result cards and inputs sitting on bg.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Panel heads, skeleton base, tags, draft and low-priority pills, the plain notice.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel and card outlines, row dividers, the header rule, input borders. Decorative; under 3:1, so inputs also rely on their surface and label.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings, panel titles and row titles on bg, surface and surface-2 (15:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Descriptions, empty-state copy, stats lines on bg, surface and surface-2 (4.9:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, ids, timestamps, freshness and footer notes in mono, on bg, surface and surface-2 (4.6:1 or better in both themes). Darkened from the source's #948c78 / #726c60, which fell to about 3:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ochre: the accented word in a page title, primary buttons, focus rings, links, the 'loading' status dot. As text, on surface (4.7:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Stale banners, caveat notices and high-priority pills, with accent as their text. Light theme accent on it is 3.6:1, under 4.5:1 (source value).

tokens.name: accent-contrast
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills (buttons). 4.5:1 light, 8:1 dark.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Live / loaded status dot, completed rows and pills, success action text.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Completed pill fill, with ok as text (4.3:1 light, under 4.5:1; 6.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error status dot, canceled rows, urgent pills, failed action text.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Urgent and canceled pill fill, with danger as text (4.2:1 light, under 4.5:1; 5.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: started
tokens.usage: Blue for in-progress and ready-for-review: row edge and pill text.

tokens.name: started-soft
tokens.usage: In-progress and ready pill fill, with started as text (5.3:1 light, 5.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: backlog
tokens.usage: Backlog, unstarted and triage: row edge and pill text.

tokens.name: backlog-soft
tokens.usage: Backlog pill fill, with backlog as text (4.3:1 light, under 4.5:1; 5:1 dark).

families.mono: ui-monospace, "JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The one h1 in the page header; its accented word takes accent.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: Issue, PR and log row titles; result card names at 0.875rem/700.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase line above the page title: what the page connects to.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Pill vertical padding; meta gap rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Header description top margin; tag gaps; row grid row-gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Tag horizontal padding; small stacks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a meta line, form rows and banners; stale banner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Stat grid gap; result card padding (10/12); icon-to-text gap in panel heads is 9px.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Row grid column gap; button horizontal padding; result card padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Panel head vertical padding; stat card horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel head, row and banner horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Gap between panels and between grid columns.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Shell side padding; header bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Header bottom margin; footer top margin.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Shell top padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags and inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pills and skeleton bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, the plain notice.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Result cards and caveat notices.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Stat cards.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels and stat cards only. Nothing else floats.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Status dot diameter.

tokens.name: row-edge
tokens.usage: Left state edge on list rows.

tokens.name: shell-narrow
tokens.usage: Single-panel pages.

tokens.name: shell-wide
tokens.usage: Two-panel console pages.
